public_headers.name: returnCorrectionDisplacementLinear_at_actual
returnCorrectionVelocityLinear_apply
public_headers.header:
theorem returnCorrectionVelocityLinear_apply
    (D : ReferenceData) (S : PhysicalSpacesData) (C : NonlinearGeometryData S)
    (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (z : AnnularState S × ℝ) (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint)
    (ρ : CircleSpace S) :
    returnCorrectionVelocityLinear D S C χ z m p ρ =
      deriv (C.minusFlow z m p.1) (Function.invFun (C.minusFlow z m p.1) p.2) *
        deriv (χ m) p.1 *
        returnCorrectionDisplacementLinear S C z m
          (Function.invFun
            (returnInterpolation (χ m p.1) (returnCorrectionInitialMap S C z m))
            (Function.invFun (C.minusFlow z m p.1) p.2)) ρ

public_headers.name: returnCorrectionVelocityLinear_at_actual
N01Properties.returnCorrectionInitialCircle_decode
public_headers.header:
theorem N01Properties.returnCorrectionInitialCircle_decode
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (z : StateDirections S × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
    (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode (hN.returnCorrectionInitialCircle hS hT z) m θ =
      returnCorrectionInitialMap S C (liftSectorParameter S C z) m θ - θ

public_headers.name: N01Properties.selectorInverseSlopeCircle_decode
public_headers.header:
theorem N01Properties.selectorInverseSlopeCircle_decode
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (rsel : ℕ → ℝ) (hrsel : ∀ m, rsel m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m))
    (z : StateDirections S × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
    (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode (hN.selectorInverseSlopeCircle hS hT rsel hrsel z) m θ =
      deriv (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C z) m (rsel m))
        (Function.invFun (C.minusFlow (liftSectorParameter S C z) m (rsel m)) θ) - 1

public_headers.name: N01Properties.interpolationInverseComposeCircle_decode
public_headers.header:
theorem N01Properties.interpolationInverseComposeCircle_decode
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hχrange : ∀ m r, r ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m) → χ m r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (rsel : ℕ → ℝ) (hrsel : ∀ m, rsel m ∈ Icc (C.left m) (C.right m))
    (z : StateDirections S × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε)
    (u : CircleSpace S) (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode
      (circlePositiveInverseComposeLinear (hS.2.1 (3 / 4 : ℝ)) hT hN.1.1 (by norm_num)
        (fun _ => 0) (hN.interpolationSelectorCircle hS hT χ hχrange rsel hrsel z) u) m θ =
      (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).decode u m
        (Function.invFun (returnInterpolation (χ m (rsel m))
          (returnCorrectionInitialMap S C (liftSectorParameter S C z) m)) θ)

public_headers.name: N01Properties.opticalCutoff_iteratedDeriv_le_sample_M
public_headers.header:
theorem N01Properties.opticalCutoff_iteratedDeriv_le_sample_M
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (j : ℕ → ℕ) (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcutoff : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ A P : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ P ∧ ∀ m r,
      |iteratedDeriv k (χ m) r| ≤ A * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ P) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ m r,
      |iteratedDeriv k (χ m) r| ≤ K * T.M (T.sample m)

public_headers.name: N01Properties.opticalCutoffJetCircleLinear_uniform_bound
public_headers.header:
theorem N01Properties.opticalCutoffJetCircleLinear_uniform_bound
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (j : ℕ → ℕ) (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hcutoff : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ A P : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ P ∧ ∀ m r,
      |iteratedDeriv k (χ m) r| ≤ A * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ P)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ rsel s u,
      (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).grading s
        (hN.opticalCutoffJetCircleLinear hS hT j hcell χ hcutoff k rsel u) ≤
      K * (S.circle (3 / 4 : ℝ)).grading (s + 1) u

public_headers.name: circleComponentContractionLinear_grading_le
public_headers.header:
theorem circleComponentContractionLinear_grading_le (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S)
    (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ m, |c m| ≤ 1) (s : ℕ) (u : S.Space) :
    S.grading s (circleComponentContractionLinear hS c hc u) ≤ S.grading s u

public_headers.name: circleProduct_oneHigh_bound
public_headers.header:
theorem circleProduct_oneHigh_bound
    (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hinterp : HasInterpolation S.grading) :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ s, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u v : S.Space,
      S.grading s (circleProductBilinear hS hT hD hγ u v) ≤
        C * (S.grading (s + loss) u * S.grading base v +
          S.grading base u * S.grading (s + loss) v)

public_headers.name: N01Properties.sectorFlowMixedTower_bound
public_headers.header:
theorem N01Properties.sectorFlowMixedTower_bound
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m a b p (hab : a + b ≤ s)
      (hp : p.1 ∈ Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m)),
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε, ∀ v : Fin k → (StateDirections S × ℝ),
        min (p.1 - C.left m) (C.right m - p.1) ^ a *
            |(hN.sectorFlowMixedTower m a b p hp).D k z v| ≤
          B * T.H (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
            T.E0 (T.sample (C.cell m)) ^ B *
            oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
              base (s + loss + d) z v

      (fun x : (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint =>
        returnCorrectionVelocityLinear D S C χ (liftSectorParameter S C x.1)
          m x.2 (R.residual (liftSectorParameter S C x.1)))
